generation.program:
(rule!
  (let* ((target (count-where (lambda (v) (= v 1)) (row g 0)))
         (body (subgrid g 1 0 (- (rows g) 1) (- (cols g) 1)))
         (chosen (find-first (lambda (obj) (= (obj-size obj) target))
                             (objects (keep-only body 3) 0))))
    (if (eq? chosen #f)
        (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)
        (paint-cells (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)
                     (map (lambda (p) (list (+ (first p) 1) (second p))) (obj-cells chosen))
                     8))))
